# BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Unge

BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Unge is a child and adolescent psychiatric clinic located in the Region Midtjylland area of Denmark [^src1][^src3][^src4]. It is described in the source material as a department under, and listed within, [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] [^src2][^src14]. The clinic appears repeatedly throughout the Danish ADHD quality database (ADHD-databasen) reports for two consecutive reporting periods — 01.04.2023–31.03.2024 and 01.04.2024–31.03.2025 — as one of the child and adolescent psychiatric units whose ADHD diagnostic and treatment pathways are benchmarked against national quality indicators [^src9].

The clinic's headline significance in the corpus is its performance on **Indicator 3**, which measures diagnostic conferences held within 120 days of the start of an ADHD assessment. In the 2023 report, BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Unge achieved 35% fulfilment of Indicator 3 among 26 assessment pathways (9 out of 26, 95% CI 17–56) [^src1]. This placed the clinic in the middle of a national picture where fulfilment of the 90% development target was generally poor across Danish regions and departments.

On other indicators, the clinic's results were markedly weaker. For **Indicator 4** (coordinating network meetings held within 90 days of treatment start), the clinic reported only 1% fulfilment (5 out of 381 pathways, 95% CI 0–3) in the 2023 report [^src2], and this figure was singled out in the same report as the low end of a national range that spanned "from 1% (BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Unge i Midtjylland) to 64%" seen at Odense's child and adolescent psychiatric outpatient clinic [^src3]. The following year's report (2024) again flagged the clinic at the bottom of the same indicator, noting that "results among departments with a minimum of three pathways varied from 1% at BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Unge" up to 52% at the Esbjerg child and adolescent psychiatric outpatient clinic [^src7], with the underlying figure recorded as just 1% (4 out of 393 pathways, 95% CI 0–3) [^src7].

The clinic's numbers improved on some other measures reported in 2024: 44% fulfilment on one indicator among 103 of 232 pathways (95% CI 38–51) [^src5][^src6], 27% on another among 108 of 393 pathways (95% CI 23–32) [^src8], and a notably higher 81% figure among 317 of 393 pathways (95% CI 76–84) tied to reporting to the ADHD database itself [^src9]. Elsewhere, the 2024 report recorded very low or near-zero results for the clinic — 0 out of 7 pathways (95% CI 0–41) [^src10] and 3% (95% CI 0–14) on an unspecified indicator with incomplete denominator data [^src11] — alongside a markedly stronger 76% (28 of 37 pathways, 95% CI 59–88) on another measure [^src12], and a raw count of 31 pathways recorded without further context [^src13].

The 2023 report also singles out the clinic for a specific weakness in somatic assessment practice, stating that it "rapporterer meget få forløb med somatisk udredning (4%)" — reports very few pathways with somatic assessment (4%) [^src14].

Across both reports, BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Unge is consistently tied to Region Midtjylland, both as its geographic location [^src1][^src3][^src4] and as an administrative unit under that region [^src2][^src14], and it is described as reporting its results into the national [[adhd-databasen|ADHD-databasen]] [^src9]. Within the broader story of the ADHD-databasen reports, the clinic is repeatedly used as an example of a department at or near the bottom of national rankings on process indicators such as network meetings and diagnostic conferences, in contrast to better-performing departments such as [[odense-boerne-ungdomspsykiatrisk-ambulatorium|Odense: Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium]] and [[esbjerg-boerne-ungdomspsykiatrisk-ambulatorium|PSY Børne- Og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium (Esbjerg)]].

## Claims

**Performance**
- BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Unge opnåede 35 % opfyldelse af Indikator 3 blandt 26 udredningsforløb [^src3]
- Ingen afdelinger nåede udviklingsmålet og resultaterne blandt afdelinger med minimum tre forløb varierede fra 1 % på BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Unge til 52 % på PSY Børne- Og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium (Esbjerg) [^src1]

**Facility-performance**
- BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Unge havde 1 % opfyldelse af indikator 4 (95% CI: 0-3) med 5 forløb ud af 381 [^src1]

**Performance-metric**
- På afdelingsniveau spænder målopfyldelsen fra 1 % (BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Unge i Midtjylland) til 64 % (Odense: Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium) [^src1]
